newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Chemicals to take $6 mln Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Chemicals to take $6 mln Q3 charge.

text.p: Sterling Chemicals Holdings Inc said Tuesday that as a result of prepaying a portion of its existing term loans, it will incur a pre-tax extraordinary charge of approximately $6 million during the third fiscal quarter.

The company added that the net proceeds from the notes were used to prepay amounts outstanding under Sterling's term loan facilities with certain senior lenders, and that the prepayment was made in a manner that significantly reduces its required principal payments over the next four fiscal years.
Sterling manufactures petrochemicals, pulp chemicals and acrylic fibers, and provides large-scale chlorine dioxide generators to the pulp and paper industry.
